words.text: I came in carrying something I could not name. I left lighter, and with a practice I still keep every Amavasya.
Gentle, direct and never once made me feel judged. The reading said what I already knew but was afraid to say.
The first space where I could bring all of myself, my identity included, and be met with respect.
The protection work was explained so clearly. I understood every step and why it mattered.
Learning with Sarvakali changed how I pray. Patient, deep, and full of humour.
After months of feeling stuck, one conversation opened things up. I finally slept that night.
